decisions.label: Cauldron reach (m)
decisions.note: How far round the pot its smoke reaches: every witch on foot in the house within it while the smoke lasts takes the potion (Ed, 2026-11-03: "10m cauldron reach is fine"). It replaced the pot's room.

decisions.label: Smoke lasts (s)
decisions.note: How long the brew's smoke hangs over the reach; anyone who walks into it meanwhile takes the potion, once (Ed, 2026-11-03: "for ten seconds or so, and if you walk into it you are affected by the potion").
